note: Regenerate after every migration approval. See docs/audits/unapplied-migrations.md. Entries listed in executorAppliedDuplicates below were APPENDED after the 2026-08-05 snapshot and were NOT read from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations — that relation is unreadable by both parties (convention §1a). Their provenance and the object-level evidence for each are recorded there.

executorAppliedDuplicates.why_this_block_exists: Lovable re-timestamps and re-authors every migration it applies, writing an 'applied duplicate' file into supabase/migrations/ under its own applied version. Those duplicates originate no new intent: each carries an intent that is already governed by a release receipt. Per the receipt gate's contract (src/test/regression/migration-release-receipt-gate.test.ts) an APPLIED migration is governed by this applied-versions baseline, not by a second receipt of its own — writing a rival receipt for a duplicate would create two receipts, and two verification statuses, for one change.
executorAppliedDuplicates.evidence_standard: Convention §1a: a schema_migrations row is not evidence and cannot be read by anyone here. Each entry below therefore states OBJECT-LEVEL evidence, or states plainly that there is none. An entry with no object evidence is recorded as provenance only and must not be read as verification.
